notes: Model-family classification. The FIRST family whose 'pattern' (case-insensitive regex) matches the model name wins; the family with an empty pattern is the catch-all and must come last. The what-if routing panel models shifting traffic from frontier_family to sonnet_family at the sonnet family's observed cost/request (falling back to its reference_cpr_usd when request volume is thin). Update the patterns as model lines evolve — no code changes needed.
